name: aio-code-review
description: Google's engineering code-review playbook — turns Claude into a thoughtful reviewer or a disciplined CL author. The 8 things every reviewer looks for (design/functionality/complexity/tests/naming/comments/style/docs), the LGTM threshold ("improves code health, not perfection"), how to write courteous comments, how to handle pushback, how to write good CL descriptions, and how to keep CLs small. Source: github.com/google/eng-practices (CC-BY 3.0).
